core.title: Alarm Lock Series Electronic Digital Lock With Audit Trail DL3000

text.description_html:
Electronic battery operated digital lock. Holds up to 300 codes, Master, Management, Supervisor & basic user. 150 event schedule, real time clock & 1,600 event audit trail.

PROGRAMMING: Locking modes, event schedules, group, individual, master, management, passage, emergency service codes. Lockout, remote override capability and allowable entry time (3, 10 or 15 seconds), are programmable


AUDIT TRAIL: Lock's activity log can be extracted by using the AL-DTMIII (data transfer module), the AL-PCI2 (PC interface) and/or can be on-site printed using the AL-IR1 (hand-held infrared printer)

OPERATION: Authorized digital code allows lever to retract latch.

Specifications:

  • 300 user with multilevel security - master, manager, supervisor, basic users and one-time service code.
  • 1600 event audit trail log, stamped by day, date, time and user.
  • 150 scheduled automatic lock/unlock events including 4 quick schedules for programming the most common time schedules
  • Fingertip (keypad) or Window PC programmable.
  • Relay may be programmed to energize on one or more selected events.
  • Durable BHMA Grade 1 lockset.
  • Vandal proof all-metal keypads.
  • Specify WP weatherproof model with temperature range of -31° to + 151°F
  • Non-handed for easy installation.
  • 5AA Battery operated; 80,000 cycles, typical.
  • Satin Chrome Finish
  • Schlage "C" IC Prep Cylinder NOT included


    • Questions? Call Customer Service 1-954-776-5340
